source: Figma local variables plus inspected V2 questionnaire properties
verifiedScope: 37 exported local variables, 28 mapped application tokens and V2 questionnaire visual foundations; not a whole-application visual sign-off
adaptations: V2 nodes have no variable bindings: foreground #182033 and border #E2E5EC override library #17192B and #E3E5EC only inside questionnaire.
V2 vector paths use a 32px card, 14px fields and 16px CTA; preserved as questionnaire-specific tokens instead of replacing library radii.
Budget, exact date, household, consent, session logout and busy/error behavior remain functional; unsupported goal directions are disabled.
Hover, error and disabled states are implementation adaptations, not exported component variants.
Manrope is bundled for Web; Expo receives shared token values, not the Web font loader.
policy: Changes to the snapshot or mapping require deliberate Figma export review; builds resolve aliases offline and reject unmapped changes to verified values.
